page.overview:
What is Adventure Fredbear?

is an unlockable character in FNaF World. He is a guide who explains how the game works as the player progresses through it.

Fredbear is a golden-colored animatronic bear, with cyan eyes, wearing a purple bowtie and a top hat, appearing as a smaller version of his counterpart from the Five Nights at Freddy's 4 minigames. Also, if one looks closely, he lacks some joints (such as his kneecaps), and unlike his core series counterpart, he has two buttons and only four fingers.

Fredbear is a powerful and helpful character. His Mega Bite can deal large amounts of damage, making him useful at attacking groups of enemies, and Mimic Ball helps by doubling the attack. Mimic Ball is also great as it helps out the party and stays for up to twelve uses. Regen Song makes the party's health regenerate over time, making Fredbear a good healer as well. Fredbear is an all-around character being very strong and assists the party.

The FNaF Show - Episode 8 ft. Chris McCullough (Fredbear & Vlad)|Dawko's interview with Chris McCullough, the voice provider of Fredbear's FNaF World version.
